headline: Indianapolis moves toward data-center pause amid protests
body: A quiet day. An Indianapolis council committee voted 10-3 to pause new data-center approvals until the end of 2027, joining temporary moratoriums in at least 17 Indiana counties. Rising Tech Backlash nudges Reversion up a little. Other lines drifted as earlier stories faded. Horizon Balance: +1.78.
